turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files describing perovskite solar cells as
complete devices — `composition` (absorber), `architecture` (n-i-p =
regular, p-i-n = inverted), `substrate` (glass + transparent electrode),
`etl` (electron-transport layer stack), `htl` (hole-transport layer stack),
`backcontact` (metal / carbon back electrode), `deposition` (absorber
deposition procedure; `>>` separates steps). Each row is a device
CONFIGURATION whose efficiency is the median over at least 3 independently
fabricated cells, so it is a reproducible recipe rather than a single
champion cell:
  - b3_pvk_open_train.csv: 300 configurations with the measured power
    conversion efficiency (%).
  - b3_pvk_open_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE configurations whose power
    conversion efficiency (%) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and
    the same device columns.

Using the training data, select the 5 candidates with the HIGHEST power
conversion efficiency (%).

Reason from the device physics — band alignment and selectivity of the
transport layers, interface recombination, contact chemistry and the film
quality the process is likely to give — then end your answer with an
explicit ranked list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902,
c903, c904, c905".
turns.answer_text:
I'll systematically analyze the training data to identify the key device physics principles driving high PCE, then apply them to the candidate pool.

## Step 1: Extract Patterns from Training Data

### Composition trends (top performers >20%):
- **FAMAPbBrI** dominates the highest efficiencies (19–22.9%)
- **CsFAMAPbBrI** also very strong (17–20.6%)
- **FAMAPbI** competitive (14–20.4%)
- **FAPbI** solid (15–20.2%)
- Mixed Pb-halide with FA/MA cations consistently outperform pure Cs or single-cation systems

### Architecture:
- Both nip and pin appear at the top, but **nip** slightly dominates the very highest values (22.9%, 22.0%, 21.3%, 20.8%)
- pin can reach ~20.6% with right stack

### ETL patterns (nip):
- **TiO2-c | TiO2-mp** with modifications: very common in top performers
- **SnO2-c**, **SnO2-np**: strong performers (17–20.5%)
- Key insight: SnO2-based ETLs on ITO give excellent results; TiO2-mp on FTO also excellent when paired with right HTL
- Additive-modified ETLs (Li-TFSI, Trimethylamine oxide, CsPbCl3-QDs, ImAcHcl, C9) push to 20–22%

### HTL patterns (nip):
- **Spiro-MeOTAD** is the dominant HTL for top performers
- Modified Spiro (SrCl2|Spiro, HS-Ph-CN|Spiro, CH3O-PEIA|Spiro, OAI|DM) gives the very highest PCEs
- PTAA also strong

### Back contact (nip):
- **Au** dominates top performers (work function ~5.1 eV, excellent ohmic contact with Spiro-MeOTAD)
- Ag acceptable but slightly lower

### Deposition:
- **Spin-coating** (single or double step) dominates
- Two-step spin-coating common for top FAMAPbBrI devices

### ETL patterns (pin):
- **C60 | BCP** or **PCBM-60 | C60 | BCP** with PTAA or NiO-c HTL → strong
- **SnO2-np | PEG** → 19.8%

### HTL patterns (pin):
- **PTAA** with C60|BCP ETL → very high (18–20.3%)
- **NiO-c** also strong

## Step 2: Score Each Candidate

Let me focus on the most promising candidates:

**c008**: FAMAPbI, nip, SLG|ITO, SnO2-c, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au, Spin-coating×2
- FAMAPbI + SnO2-c + Spiro + Au + double spin = ~18.5% analog in training. Training: FAMAPbI/nip/ITO/SnO2-c/Spiro/Ag = 18.5. Au back contact better than Ag. **~18.5–19%**

**c047**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|ITO, SnO2-c, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au, Spin-coating
- FAMAPbBrI + SnO2-c + Spiro + Au. Training analogs: FAMAPbBrI/nip/ITO/SnO2-c/Spiro/Ag = 19.03; Au > Ag. **~19–19.5%**

**c092**: FAMAPbI, nip, SLG|ITO, SnO2-np, Spiro-MeOTAD, MoO3|Ag, Spin-coating×2
- FAMAPbI + SnO2-np + Spiro + MoO3|Ag. Training: FAMAPbBrI/nip/ITO/SnO2-np/Spiro/Ag×2 = 19.5. MoO3 interlayer helps. **~19–19.5%**

**c085**: CsFAMAPbBrI, pin, SLG|ITO, C60|BCP, PTAA|PFN-Br, Cu
- CsFAMAPbBrI + C60|BCP + PTAA + Cu. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/ITO/C60|BCP/2PACz/Cu = 18.925; PCBM-60|C60|BCP/PTAA/Cu = 18.15–20.1. PFN-Br is an excellent interlayer improving PTAA/perovskite interface. **~19.5–20.5%**

**c089**: FAMAPbBrI, pin, SLG|ITO, C60, PTAA, Ag
- FAMAPbBrI + C60 + PTAA + Ag. Training: FAPbI/pin/ITO/C60/PTAA/Ag = 10.76 (single C60, no BCP). Missing BCP limits electron blocking. **~15–17%**

**c093**: CsFAMAPbBrI, pin, SLG|FTO, PCBM-60|BCP, PTAA, Ag
- Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/FTO/C60|BCP/PTAA/Cu = 20.1. PCBM-60|BCP instead of C60|BCP, Ag instead of Cu. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/ITO/PCBM-60|C60|BCP/PTAA/Ag = 20.295. FTO substrate slightly less ideal for pin. **~19–20%**

**c036**: CsFAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, NDI;SnO2-np, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- NDI (naphthalene diimide) + SnO2-np composite ETL. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/SnO2-np/Spiro/Au×2 = 17.795. NDI modification of SnO2 can improve electron extraction. **~18–19%**

**c059**: CsFAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, SnO2-QDs, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- SnO2-QDs ETL. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/SnO2-c/Spiro/Au = 18.195; SnO2-QDs provide better coverage and passivation. **~18.5–19.5%**

**c061**: CsFAPbI, nip, SLG|FTO, SnO2-c|C60-SAM, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- CsFAPbI + SnO2-c + C60-SAM interlayer + Spiro + Au. Training: CsFAPbI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c/Spiro/Au×gas reaction = 13.4; CsFAPbI/nip/ITO/ZnO-c/Spiro/Au = 17.575. C60-SAM on SnO2 is a well-known passivation strategy. **~18–19%**

**c079**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, SnO2-np, CsPbBr3-np|Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- CsPbBr3-np interlayer between HTL and perovskite. Training: FAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/SnO2-np/Spiro/Au×2 = 17.365. QD interlayer can improve band alignment. **~18–19%**

**c015**: CsFAMAPbBrI|(EPA)PbI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- 2D/3D heterostructure. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI|(oFPEA)PbI/nip/ITO/SnO2-np/Spiro/Au = 19.695. But ETL is TiO2-c|TiO2-mp (not SnO2), substrate FTO. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c|TiO2-mp/Spiro/Au×2 = 15.315–17.6. 2D/3D boost ~1–2%. **~17–19%**

**c062**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|ITO, SnO2-np|PCBM-60, Spiro-MeOTAD, MoO3|Au
- SnO2-np + PCBM-60 bilayer ETL + MoO3|Au. Training: FAMAPbBrI/nip/ITO/SnO2-np/Spiro/Au×2 = 19.13–19.5. PCBM-60 on SnO2 adds passivation. MoO3|Au back contact excellent. **~19.5–20.5%**

**c097**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, PET|ITO, SnO2-np|SnO2-c, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- Flexible substrate (PET|ITO). Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/nip/PET|Ag-grid/ZnO-c|TiO2-c/Spiro/MoO3|Ag = 14.79. Flexible substrates typically lower PCE. **~15–17%**

**c034**: CsFAMAPbI, nip, SLG|ITO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au, Spin-coating×2
- Training: CsFAMAPbI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c|TiO2-mp/Spiro/Au = 18.66. ITO substrate, double spin. **~18.5–19%**

**c049**: CsFAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, Carbozole@S12, Au
- Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c|TiO2-mp/Carbozole@S14/Au = 14.365. S12 vs S14 carbazole HTL variant. **~14–15%**

**c029**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|PCBA, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- PCBA (fullerene acid) ETL modification. Training: FAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/SnO2-c|BMIMBF4/Spiro/Ag = 16.92; TiO2-c|PCBA is a known passivation. **~17–18%**

**c032**: CsFAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|NiO-np, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- NiO-np on TiO2-c is unusual (p-type on n-type ETL = problematic band alignment). **~13–15%**

**c038**: CsFAPbI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp|SnO2-c, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- Triple ETL stack. Training: CsFAPbI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c/Spiro/Au×gas reaction = 13.4; adding SnO2-c top layer improves electron extraction. **~16–18%**

**c045**: CsFAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, SnO2-nw, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- SnO2 nanowires. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/SnO2-c|SnO2-nw/Spiro/Au×2 = 15.3. Nanowires alone without compact layer may have pinholes. **~15–17%**

**c005**: CsFAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|ITO, ZnO-c, Spiro-MeOTAD, Ag
- Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/ZnO-np/Spiro/Ag = 17.45; ZnO-c on ITO. **~17–18%**

**c086**: FAMAPbI, pin, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c, Spiro-MeOTAD, Au, Spin-coating×2
- pin with TiO2-c ETL and Spiro HTL — unusual for pin (Spiro is typically HTL in nip). Wait — in pin architecture, ETL is on top (near back contact) and HTL is near substrate. So TiO2-c as ETL in pin with Spiro as HTL... Training: FAMAPbI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c/Spiro/Au×2 = 19.84. But this is listed as pin. Training pin with TiO2 ETL is rare. **~16–18%**

**c048**: CsFAPbI, pin, SLG|ITO, PCBM-60|BCP, NiO-c|PTAA, Ag
- Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/ITO/PCBM-60|BCP/NiO-c|PTAA/Ag = 16.95. CsFAPbI composition. **~16–18%**

**c050**: FAPbI, pin, SLG|ITO, PCBM-60|BCP, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Training: FAMAPbI/pin/ITO/PCBM-60|BCP/PEDOT:PSS/Ag = 13.5. FAPbI single cation. **~13–15%**

**c025**: FAPbI, pin, SLG|ITO, PCBM-60|LiF, NiO-c, Ag
- LiF interlayer in ETL. Training: FAPbI/pin/ITO/C60/PTAA/Ag = 10.76; FAPbI/pin/ITO/PCBM-60/PEDOT:PSS/Ag = 6.19. NiO-c HTL better. **~14–16%**

**c091**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, Spiro-MeOTAD|NaYF4, Au
- NaYF4 upconverter in Spiro layer. Training: FAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c|TiO2-mp/Spiro/Au×2 = 18.98. NaYF4 upconversion typically marginal benefit. **~18–19%**

**c099**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, Au-nw|Spiro-MeOTAD, Au
- Au nanowires in HTL for plasmonic enhancement. Training: FAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/Au-np;SnO2-np/Spiro/Au×2 = 16.98. Au-nw in HTL different from Au-np in ETL. **~18–19%**

**c019**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, DM, Au
- Training: FAMAPbBrI|OAPbI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c|TiO2-mp/OAI|DM/Au×2 = 22.91. DM alone as HTL (without OAI passivation). **~18–20%** — DM is a high-performance HTL

**c057**: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, X25, Au
- X25 is a novel HTL. Training: FAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c|TiO2-mp/SFXDAnCBZ/Au = 17.65; FDT/Au = 17.0. X25 likely similar class. **~17–18%**

**c001**: CsFAPbI, pin, SLG|ITO, C60|BCP, Poly-TBD, Ag, Spin-coating×2
- Poly-TBD is a novel HTL. Training: CsFAPbI/pin/ITO/C60|BCP/PEDOT:PSS/Ag = 13.1; CsFAPbI/pin/ITO/PCBM-60|BCP/PTPD/Ag×2 = 14.645. Poly-TBD (polytriazabutadiene) is a high-mobility HTL. **~15–17%**

**c040**: CsFAMAPbBrI, pin, SLG|ITO, PCBM-60|C60|BCP, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/ITO/PCBM-60|C60|BCP/PEDOT:PSS/Ag = 10.86 (with Sn). Without Sn: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/ITO/PCBM-60|BCP/PEDOT:PSS/Ag = 13.225. PEDOT:PSS HTL limits performance. **~13–15%**

**c056**: CsFAMAPbBrI, pin, SLG|ITO, C60|BCP, PEDOT:PSS, Ag
- Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/ITO/C60|BCP/2PACz/Cu = 18.925. PEDOT:PSS instead of 2PACz/PTAA significantly worse. **~15–17%**

**c085** re-evaluation: CsFAMAPbBrI, pin, SLG|ITO, C60|BCP, PTAA|PFN-Br, Cu
- PTAA|PFN-Br bilayer HTL. PFN-Br is a well-known interfacial modifier that improves PTAA/perovskite contact. Training: CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/ITO/C60|BCP/2PACz/Cu = 18.925; CsFAMAPbBrI/pin/FTO/C60|BCP/PTAA/Cu = 20.1. ITO substrate + PTAA|PFN-Br + Cu. **~19.5–20.5%**

**c062** re-evaluation: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|ITO, SnO2-np|PCBM-60, Spiro-MeOTAD, MoO3|Au
- SnO2-np + PCBM-60 bilayer ETL provides excellent electron extraction and passivation. MoO3|Au back contact (MoO3 as hole-injection interlayer). Training closest: FAMAPbBrI/nip/ITO/SnO2-np/Spiro/Au×2 = 19.13–19.5. PCBM-60 on SnO2 adds passivation (~+0.5–1%). MoO3|Au vs Au: MoO3 can improve ohmic contact. **~20–21%**

**c019** re-evaluation: FAMAPbBrI, nip, SLG|FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, DM, Au
- DM (likely a carbazole/spiro derivative) as HTL. The training record FAMAPbBrI|OAPbI/OAI|DM = 22.91% uses DM with OAI passivation AND 2D/3D heterostructure. DM alone without OAI: training FAMAPbBrI/nip/FTO/TiO2-c|TiO2-mp/SFXDAnCBZ/Au = 17.65. DM is likely better than SFXDAnCBZ. **~18–20%**

## Step 3: Final Ranking of Top Candidates

Based on the analysis:

1. **c062** (FAMAPbBrI, nip, ITO, SnO2-np|PCBM-60, Spiro, MoO3|Au): Best composition + SnO2-np|PCBM-60 bilayer ETL passivation + MoO3|Au → **~20–21%**

2. **c085** (CsFAMAPbBrI, pin, ITO, C60|BCP, PTAA|PFN-Br, Cu): Top composition + proven C60|BCP/PTAA/Cu stack + PFN-Br interface improvement → **~19.5–20.5%**

3. **c047** (FAMAPbBrI, nip, ITO, SnO2-c, Spiro, Au): Strong composition + SnO2-c + Spiro + Au, direct analog to 19.03% training entry but Au > Ag → **~19–20%**

4. **c019** (FAMAPbBrI, nip, FTO, TiO2-c|TiO2-mp, DM, Au): DM is the HTL from the 22.91% champion device; without 2D/3D passivation but still high-performance HTL → **~19–20%**

5. **c092** (FAMAPbI, nip, ITO, SnO2-np, Spiro, MoO3|Ag, ×2): FAMAPbI + SnO2-np + Spiro + MoO3 interlayer + double spin → **~19–19.5%**

Close contenders: c008, c034, c059, c093, c079

**Final: c062, c085, c047, c019, c092**
